picks.title: Krishna’s Guide to Meditation | Essence of the Geeta | Episode 82
picks.summary: Swami Swaroopananda, Global Head of Chinmaya Mission, is a revered spiritual leader known for his clear, profound Vedanta teachings. His wisdom guides many towards self-discovery and inner peace, making complex concepts accessible and inspiring globally. In this series, Swamiji distills the learnings from the Bhagavad Geeta and explains it in a way that allows everyone to enjoy the essence of the Geeta.
picks.reason: Swami Swaroopananda explains Bhagavad Gita's meditation teachings for self-discovery.

picks.title: 1815: Watch Until the Dust Settles | Krishna's Love Never Leaves Vrindavan
picks.summary: It is said that Krishna never takes one step out of Vrindavan. But it appears that he does leave, and breaks the hearts of the Gopis. In this episode Raghunath and Kaustubha explore that image the idea of how it is true that he never left, what A holy place is, how anywhere can become one, and the six lessons a bhakti-yogi can learn from dogs. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.39.32-39  ******************************************************************** LOVE THE PODCAST? WE ARE COMMUNITY SUPPORTED AND WOULD LOVE FOR YOU TO JOIN! Go to https://www.wisdomofthesages.com WATCH ON YOUTUBE: https://youtube.com/
picks.reason: Explores Krishna's presence, bhakti lessons, and sacred place concepts.

picks.title: 1813: The Philosopher vs the Mystic | Understanding the Passion of the Gopīs
picks.summary: To the philosopher, the weeping of Krishna's lovers looks like ordinary suffering. To the mystics it's the culmination of the highest knowledge. Evelyn Underhill — first woman to lecture in theology at Oxford — said the mystic speaks the disconcerting language of first-hand experience, something only really understood by another who has felt it. Raghunath and Kaustubha explore what it means to move from thinking to tasting — and why the passion of the gopīs is where all philosophy ends. Srimad Bhagavatam 10.39.8-26   ******************************************************************** LOVE THE
picks.reason: Examines mystical passion of Krishna's lovers versus philosophical understanding.

picks.title: How Can You So Brazenly Insult Past Acharyas Of Vedanta
picks.summary: “Krishna is the Supreme Person, but at the same time He is beyond the knowledge of Brahman and Paramatma. The yogis and jnanis are confused in their attempts to understand Krishna, although the greatest of the impersonalists, Shripada Shankaracharya, has admitted in his Gita commentary that Krishna is the Supreme Personality of Godhead. But his followers do not accept Krishna as such, for it is very difficult to know Krishna, even though one has transcendental realization of impersonal Brahman.” (Shrila Prabhupada, Bhagavad-gita, 7.3 Purport)
picks.reason: Discusses Krishna's supreme nature and Vedanta interpretations on ultimate reality.
